title: Code and results: a test of a convolutional-recurrent network for forecasting soil organic carbon change, with the evaluation protocol fixed in advance

creators.name: Hasan, Md Rakib
creators.affiliation: Department of Soil, Water and Environment, University of Dhaka; Fermium Systems

creators.name: Rupa, Mst Anika Khatun
creators.affiliation: Department of Soil, Water and Environment, University of Dhaka

creators.name: Mohiuddin, A. S. M.
creators.affiliation: Department of Soil, Water and Environment, University of Dhaka

description: Analysis code, result tables and run logs for a test of a hybrid convolutional-recurrent architecture against gradient boosting on repeatedly sampled LUCAS topsoil observations, under an evaluation protocol fixed before the data were seen. The LUCAS source data and the panel derived from them are not redistributed, since their licence does not permit it; the code rebuilds the panel from files obtained directly from the European Soil Data Centre.
